subject: reasoning
question:
Anil starts driving from point A and drives 6 km towards east. Then he turns left and drives 2 km, then turns right and drives 3 km. Then he turns right and drives 5 km. Finally he turns right, drives 9 km, and stops at point P.

How far (minimum distance) and in which direction should he drive to reach point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Anil starts driving from Point A and drives 6 km towards the east.

He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km and then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. 

Based on the given conditions, we get the direction distance diagram as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec8ee7248e8190c310bdbded96f50fa92b211c1e142d0e07ab5650a3cd28ad96.png] 

Therefore, we see that in order to go back to Point A, he has to drive (5-2) = 3 km towards the North.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
